# PDF.js 6.4.299

Unmodified browser build, worker, CMaps, standard fonts and WASM assets from Mozilla's
`pdfjs-dist` npm package. Used only for local client-side supporting-document previews.
No document data is sent to an external viewer or CDN.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- Documentation: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz
- Verified package SHA-512: `AVl138zALtfaAPvADulE0PZThbYzCBS79nL4pOSL/6Sm/4AH5A21BD9VHt97OlCuzJuCpmeZtAtkinisF4Vb1g==`

Apache 2.0; see LICENSE and the licenses in the asset directories.
Update the library and worker together, preserve licenses, and verify PDF/image preview,
page navigation, zoom, scoped access and failure states after upgrades.
